name: bacheca
description: Bacheca universitaria — attività fra studenti (progetto SAW 2026)

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:modello && npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:modello && npm run dev --workspace api
scripts.build: npm run build:modello && npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace api
scripts.popola: npm run build:modello && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npm run popola --workspace api"
scripts.consolida: npm run build:modello && npm run consolida --workspace api
scripts.job: npm run build:modello && npm run job --workspace api
scripts.scenario: npm run build:modello && npm run scenario --workspace api --
scripts.svuota: npm run build:modello && npm run svuota --workspace api
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
